# Planner 5D

> > Planner 5D is a home design and renovation platform offering detailed cost estimation tools for materials, labor, and installation across residential construction and remodeling projects.

The platform provides comprehensive price breakdowns for home improvement projects, helping homeowners and contractors budget for renovations. Cost estimates are based on US Bureau of Labor Statistics data and include materials like Low-E glass, PVC, MDF, EPS/XPS insulation, and GFCI components, covering everything from kitchen cabinets to HVAC systems.

## Key Topics

- Cost estimation and price calculators
- Home renovation and remodeling
- Material costs (PVC, MDF, Low-E glass, EPS/XPS foam)
- Labor and installation pricing
- Kitchen renovation (cabinets, cooktops, appliances)
- Bathroom remodeling (vanities, tiling, fixtures)
- Flooring (tiles, pavers, concrete)
- HVAC systems (heat pumps, humidifiers)
- Insulation (R-13, stone wool, polystyrene)
- Exterior improvements (siding, pool decks, landscaping)
- Energy-efficient appliances
- GFCI electrical installations
- US Bureau of Labor Statistics pricing data

## Kitchen Renovation Costs

- [Cost of Base Kitchen Cabinets: Price Estimate per Unit](https://planner5d.com/costs/base-kitchen-cabinets-cost): Base kitchen cabinet pricing for renovation with material and labor costs

- [Cost of Convection Ovens: Price Estimate per Unit](https://planner5d.com/costs/convection-ovens-cost): Convection oven price guide with kitchen appliance installation costs
